info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Airline Flights Checkin-v3-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Check-in Management API facilitates the batch processing of passenger check-ins for airline flights. This endpoint allows airlines to efficiently register multiple check-ins in a single operation, improving the check-in experience for travelers. Common use cases include handling busy travel seasons or large group bookings, enabling airlines to streamline their operations and enhance customer satisfaction. This API is designed for airline personnel and application developers integrating check-in functionalities into their systems.

post.description: This endpoint allows customers to check in for their booked flights, enabling them to receive their boarding passes and select seats as needed. Ensure you have your booking reference at hand.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit check-in details for a flight. It includes all necessary information required to process the check-in, such as passenger details, flight information, and any additional preferences.
